description: PUBLICATION/SUBSCRIPTION acceptance on postgresql17 (#129): wal_level=logical anchor proves publication lifecycle for real; subscription DDL executes where a publisher can exist (self-subscription), with honest expect_rc for forms needing a live peer.

ddl_steps.name: fixture table
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t46.items (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, v text); INSERT INTO t46.items VALUES (1,'a')

ddl_steps.name: create publication
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE PUBLICATION t46_pub FOR TABLE t46.items

ddl_steps.name: create publication all tables
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE PUBLICATION t46_pub_all FOR ALL TABLES

ddl_steps.name: create publication columns
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE PUBLICATION t46_pub_cols FOR TABLE t46.items (id)

ddl_steps.name: create publication where
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE PUBLICATION t46_pub_where FOR TABLE t46.items WHERE (id > 0)

ddl_steps.name: alter publication add table
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t46.items2 (id int); ALTER PUBLICATION t46_pub ADD TABLE t46.items2

ddl_steps.name: alter publication drop/owner/rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER PUBLICATION t46_pub DROP TABLE t46.items2; ALTER PUBLICATION t46_pub RENAME TO t46_pub2

ddl_steps.name: create subscription self
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE SUBSCRIPTION t46_sub CONNECTION 'host=localhost port=5432 dbname=postgres user=postgres' PUBLICATION t46_pub2 WITH (connect = true, create_slot = false, enabled = false)

ddl_steps.name: alter subscription set publication
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER SUBSCRIPTION t46_sub SET PUBLICATION t46_pub2, t46_pub_cols WITH (refresh = false)

ddl_steps.name: alter subscription disable/enable
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER SUBSCRIPTION t46_sub DISABLE; ALTER SUBSCRIPTION t46_sub ENABLE

ddl_steps.name: alter subscription owner/rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER SUBSCRIPTION t46_sub RENAME TO t46_sub2

ddl_steps.name: drop subscription
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER SUBSCRIPTION t46_sub2 DISABLE; ALTER SUBSCRIPTION t46_sub2 SET (slot_name = NONE); DROP SUBSCRIPTION IF EXISTS t46_sub2

ddl_steps.name: drop publications
ddl_steps.sql: DROP PUBLICATION t46_pub2, t46_pub_all, t46_pub_cols, t46_pub_where

setup.name: snapshot owned catalog entries
setup.sql:
CREATE TABLE pgrepl_1.receipt AS SELECT p.pubname, p.pubowner, p.puballtables, p.pubinsert,p.pubupdate,p.pubdelete,p.pubtruncate,p.pubviaroot,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(r.prrelid, r.prattrs, r.prqual::text) ORDER BY r.prrelid) FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication_rel r WHERE r.prpubid=p.oid) AS relations,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(n.pnnspid ORDER BY n.pnnspid) FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication_namespace n WHERE n.pnpubid=p.oid) AS schemas
FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication p WHERE p.pubname IN ('pgrepl_1_pub','pgrepl_1_pub_all','pgrepl_1_pub_cols','pgrepl_1_pub_root','pgrepl_1_pub_schemas')

CREATE TABLE pgrepl_64.receipt AS SELECT subname,subowner,subenabled,subslotname IS NOT NULL AS slot_present,subpublications,subbinary,substream,subskiplsn
FROM pg_catalog.pg_subscription WHERE subdbid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AND subname IN ('pgrepl_64_sub','pgrepl_64_named_slot','pgrepl_64 DISABLE')

post_verify.sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM ((TABLE pgrepl_64.receipt EXCEPT (SELECT subname,subowner,subenabled,subslotname IS NOT NULL AS slot_present,subpublications,subbinary,substream,subskiplsn
FROM pg_catalog.pg_subscription WHERE subdbid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AND subname IN ('pgrepl_64_sub','pgrepl_64_named_slot','pgrepl_64 DISABLE'))) UNION ALL ((SELECT subname,subowner,subenabled,subslotname IS NOT NULL AS slot_present,subpublications,subbinary,substream,subskiplsn
FROM pg_catalog.pg_subscription WHERE subdbid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AND subname IN ('pgrepl_64_sub','pgrepl_64_named_slot','pgrepl_64 DISABLE')) EXCEPT TABLE pgrepl_64.receipt)) AS delta

execute.name: run native PostgreSQL DDL in owned transaction
execute.sql: BEGIN; ALTER SUBSCRIPTION pgrepl_64_sub SET (binary=1); SELECT 'changed='||(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_subscription WHERE subdbid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AND subname='pgrepl_64_sub' AND subbinary))::text; ROLLBACK;
